summary: Iteration 5 testing complete for the 4 new features: (1) Theme-aware header, (2) Install button + fallback modal, (3) PWA assets (manifest.json, sw.js, icon-192/512), (4) Home hero large logo above eyebrow, (5) Article Preview dialog. All 5 new-feature checks pass end-to-end. Backend PWA static assets return 200 with correct content types. Frontend Playwright verified theme toggle switches header bg (rgba(255,255,255,0.95) <-> rgba(11,19,43,0.95)), toggles html.dark class, persists via localStorage.hl_theme across reload; install-app-btn opens install-modal (Android/iOS guidance) in headless (no beforeinstallprompt) as expected; hero LogoMark (112px) renders above the 'Quality care, brighter tomorrows' eyebrow; article-preview-dialog renders title + rich HTML content without saving to DB, closes on Escape, and form state is preserved after closing preview.
critical_code_review_comments: InstallButton.jsx returns null when isStandalone() is true — good, but there is no visible confirmation state after appinstalled fires; consider a toast for feedback.
AdminDashboard.jsx now 652 lines — continue considering split per tab (previously flagged).
manifest.json uses relative icon src (e.g. 'favicon.png') without leading slash; with start_url '.', this works today but a leading '/' would be safer for scope='/'.
seed_data_creation: None — Article Preview flow does not save to DB (verified via GET /api/articles filter TEST_ITER5_ = 0). Form was cancelled without saving.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin login route is /admin (NOT /admin/login) which redirects to /admin/dashboard after auth. Theme state persists in localStorage 'hl_theme'; light bg = rgba(255,255,255,0.95), dark bg = rgba(11,19,43,0.95). Headless Chromium never fires beforeinstallprompt, so install-app-btn always opens install-modal fallback — treat that as pass. Preview article dialog reads form values directly and does NOT call POST /api/admin/articles.
